```{julia}
              coefnames = r.coefnames, n = r.n_obs,
              stats = Dict("N"       => r.n_obs,
                           "r2_o"    => r2s.r2_o,
                           "r2_b"    => r2s.r2_b,
                           "r2_w"    => r2s.r2_w,
                           "sigma_u" => r.σ_u,
                           "sigma_e" => r.σ_ε,
                           "rho"     => r.ρ))
end

"""
    xtreg_re_table_ss(res; level=0.95)

Pretty-print a NamedTuple produced by `xtreg_re` in Stata's exact layout.
"""
function xtreg_re_table_ss(res; level::Float64=0.95)
    crit = Distributions.quantile(Distributions.Normal(), 1 - (1-level)/2)
    lo   = res.β .- crit .* res.se
    hi   = res.β .+ crit .* res.se
    q    = length(res.β) - 1                          # # slopes

    _fmtn(x) = replace(string(x), r"(\d)(?=(\d{3})+$)" => s"\1,")
    _g(x, w) = begin
        (ismissing(x) || !isfinite(x)) && return Printf.@sprintf("%*s", w, ".")
        s = Printf.@sprintf("%.7g", x)
        0 < abs(x) < 1 && (s = replace(s, r"^(-?)0\." => s"\1."))
        Printf.@sprintf("%*s", w, s)
    end

    # ── Header block
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10s\n", "Random-effects GLS regression",
                   "Number of obs", _fmtn(res.n_obs))
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10s\n", "Group variable: id",
                   "Number of groups", _fmtn(res.n_panels))
    println()
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%s\n", "R-squared:", "Obs per group:")
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10d\n",
                   Printf.@sprintf("     Within  = %.4f", res.r2_within),
                   "                  min", res.T_min)
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10.1f\n",
                   Printf.@sprintf("     Between = %.4f", res.r2_between),
                   "                  avg", res.T̄)
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10d\n",
                   Printf.@sprintf("     Overall = %.4f", res.r2_overall),
                   "                  max", res.T_max)
    println()
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10.2f\n", "",
                   "Wald chi2($q)", res.Wald)
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10.4f\n",
                   "corr(u_i, X) = 0 (assumed)", "Prob > chi2", res.Wald_p)
    println()

    # ── Coefficient table (z, P>|z|)
    lvl  = round(Int, 100 * level)
    println("-"^78)
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %10s  %9s  %6s  %5s     [%d%% conf. interval]\n",
                   string(res.y_name), "Coefficient", "Std. err.",
                   "z", "P>|z|", lvl)
    println("-"^13, "+", "-"^64)
    for i in eachindex(res.β)
        nm = res.coefnames[i]
        Printf.@printf("%12s | %s  %s  %6.2f  %5.3f  %s  %s\n",
                       nm, _g(res.β[i], 10), _g(res.se[i], 9),
                       res.z[i], res.p[i],
                       _g(lo[i], 11), _g(hi[i], 10))
    end
    println("-"^13, "+", "-"^64)
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s\n", "sigma_u", _g(res.σ_u, 10))
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s\n", "sigma_e", _g(res.σ_ε, 10))
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s   (fraction of variance due to u_i)\n",
                   "rho", _g(res.ρ, 10))
    println("-"^78)
    return nothing
end

"""
    correlate(df, vars)

Stata-style `correlate var1 var2 ...`. Prints a lower-triangular correlation
matrix on pairwise-complete rows, with row labels like Stata.
"""
function correlate(df, vars::AbstractVector)
    m = Matrix{Float64}(undef, DataFrames.nrow(df), length(vars))
    for (j, v) in enumerate(vars)
        m[:, j] = [ismissing(x) ? NaN : Float64(_rawval(x)) for x in df[!, Symbol(v)]]
    end
    keep = .!any(isnan, m; dims=2)[:]
    m = m[keep, :]
    n = size(m, 1)
    C = Statistics.cor(m)
    disp = [i < j ? "" : Printf.@sprintf("%.4f", C[i, j])
            for i in 1:length(vars), j in 1:length(vars)]
    println("(obs = $n)")
    out = DataFrames.DataFrame()
    out[!, :Variable] = string.(vars)
    for (j, v) in enumerate(vars)
        out[!, Symbol(v)] = disp[:, j]
    end
    _pt_compat(out; alignment=:r)
    return (; cor=C, n=n, vars=string.(vars))
end

"""
    boot_regtable(β, β_boot; coefnames, title="", level=0.95)

Stata-style regression table from a point estimate `β` and a `B × k` matrix of
bootstrap replicates `β_boot`. Reports Coef / Bootstrap SE / z / P>|z| / CI
exactly like Stata prints after `vce(boot)`.
"""
function boot_regtable(β::AbstractVector, β_boot::AbstractMatrix;
                       coefnames, title::String = "", level::Float64 = 0.95)
    se   = Statistics.std(β_boot, dims=1)[:]
    z    = β ./ se
    pval = 2 .* (1 .- Distributions.cdf.(Distributions.Normal(), abs.(z)))
    crit = Distributions.quantile(Distributions.Normal(), 1 - (1-level)/2)
    lo   = β .- crit .* se
    hi   = β .+ crit .* se
    isempty(title) || println(title)
    Printf.@printf("  (bootstrap replications = %d)\n\n", size(β_boot, 1))
    _pt_compat(
        DataFrames.DataFrame(
            variable   = string.(coefnames),
            estimate   = β,
            boot_se    = se,
            z          = z,
            p          = pval,
            ci_lo      = lo,
            ci_hi      = hi);
        formatters = PrettyTables.ft_printf("%.6f", 2:7))
    return (; β, se, z, p=pval, ci_lo=lo, ci_hi=hi)
end

"""
    panel_bootstrap(f, df, idvar; B=400, seed=10101)

Cluster bootstrap on the panel identifier `idvar`. Applies the user-supplied
function `f(df_resampled)` on each resample and returns a matrix `B × k` of
the vectors `f` returns (one row per replicate).

Useful for computing `vce(boot, reps(B) seed(s))`-style SEs for any estimator.
"""
function panel_bootstrap(f::Function, df, idvar::Symbol; B::Int=400, seed::Int=10101,
                         verbose::Bool=true)
    rng = Random.MersenneTwister(seed)
    ids = unique(df[!, idvar])
    # Pre-index rows by id for faster resampling (avoids O(B*N*n) filtering)
    id_to_rows = Dict{Any, Vector{Int}}()
    for (i, id) in enumerate(df[!, idvar])
        push!(get!(id_to_rows, id, Int[]), i)
    end
    results = Vector{Vector{Float64}}()
    n_fail = 0
    for b in 1:B
        boot_ids = StatsBase.sample(rng, ids, length(ids); replace=true)
        # Each sampled cluster gets a fresh unique id so duplicates are not
        # merged by panel estimators. This matches Stata's `bootstrap, cluster()`.
        row_idx = Int[]
        new_id  = Int[]
        for (k, i) in enumerate(boot_ids)
            rows = id_to_rows[i]
            append!(row_idx, rows)
            append!(new_id, fill(k, length(rows)))
        end
        sub = df[row_idx, :]
        sub[!, idvar] = new_id
        try
            push!(results, f(sub))
        catch
            n_fail += 1
        end
    end
    if verbose && n_fail > 0
        @warn "Bootstrap: $n_fail/$B resamples failed (skipped)."
    end
    isempty(results) && error("All bootstrap resamples failed.")
    return reduce(hcat, results)'   # B × k matrix
end

"""
    xtregar(df, yvar, xvars, panelvar, timevar; method=:fe)

Stata-style `xtregar` — FE or RE with panel AR(1) error correction.
Estimates a common AR(1) coefficient ρ from FE within-residuals,
applies Prais-Winsten transformation, then runs FE-within or
Swamy-Arora RE on the transformed data.
"""
function xtregar(df, yvar::Symbol, xvars::Vector{Symbol},
                 panelvar::Symbol, timevar::Symbol;
                 method::Symbol = :fe)   # :fe or :re
    d = sort(DataFrames.dropmissing(df, vcat([yvar, panelvar, timevar], xvars)),
             [panelvar, timevar])
    panels = sort(unique(d[!, panelvar]))
    N = length(panels)
    pidx = Dict(g => findall(==(g), d[!, panelvar]) for g in panels)

    k = length(xvars)
    y_raw = Float64.(d[!, yvar])
    X_raw = hcat(ones(nrow(d)), hcat([Float64.(d[!, v]) for v in xvars]...))

    # — Step 1: FE within → residuals → ρ̂ (Baltagi-Wu) —
    m_fe = FixedEffectModels.reg(d, term(yvar) ~ sum(term.(xvars)) + FixedEffectModels.fe(panelvar))
    e_fe = y_raw .- X_raw[:, 2:end] * StatsBase.coef(m_fe)
    # demean residuals within panel to get within residuals
    for g in panels
        idx = pidx[g]
        e_fe[idx] .-= mean(e_fe[idx])
    end
    num_rho = 0.0; den_rho = 0.0
    for g in panels
        idx = pidx[g]
        ei = e_fe[idx]
        for t in 2:length(ei)
            num_rho += ei[t] * ei[t-1]
            den_rho += ei[t-1]^2
        end
    end
    ρ = clamp(num_rho / den_rho, -0.999, 0.999)

    # — Step 2: Quasi-demean (Prais-Winsten) —
    ỹ = similar(y_raw)
    X̃ = similar(X_raw)
    s1 = sqrt(1 - ρ^2)
    for g in panels
        idx = pidx[g]
        ỹ[idx[1]]      = s1 * y_raw[idx[1]]
        X̃[idx[1], :]   = s1 .* X_raw[idx[1], :]
        for t in 2:length(idx)
            ỹ[idx[t]]    = y_raw[idx[t]] - ρ * y_raw[idx[t-1]]
            X̃[idx[t], :] = X_raw[idx[t], :] .- ρ .* X_raw[idx[t-1], :]
        end
    end

    if method == :fe
        # Within transform on PW-transformed data
        for g in panels
            idx = pidx[g]
            ỹ[idx] .-= mean(ỹ[idx])
            for j in axes(X̃, 2)
                X̃[idx, j] .-= mean(X̃[idx, j])
            end
        end
        X_est = X̃[:, 2:end]   # drop constant (absorbed by FE)
        β = X_est \ ỹ
        u = ỹ .- X_est * β
        n_obs = length(ỹ)
        dof = n_obs - N - k
        σ2 = sum(abs2, u) / dof
        V = σ2 .* inv(X_est' * X_est)
        se = sqrt.(max.(diag(V), 0.0))
        # Recover constant as mean(y - Xβ) across panel means of original data
        panel_means = DataFrames.combine(DataFrames.groupby(d, panelvar),
            yvar => (x -> mean(Float64.(x))) => :ym,
            [v => (x -> mean(Float64.(x))) => Symbol(v, :_m) for v in xvars]...)
        cons = mean(panel_means.ym .- sum(β[j] * panel_means[!, Symbol(xvars[j], :_m)]
                                          for j in 1:k))
        β_full = vcat(β, [cons])
        se_full = vcat(se, [NaN])
        V_full = zeros(k+1, k+1); V_full[1:k, 1:k] = V
        cnames = vcat(string.(xvars), "_cons")
    else  # :re — Swamy-Arora on PW data
        # Estimate variance components from PW data
        # FE within on PW data
        X_pw_w = copy(X̃[:, 2:end]); ỹ_w = copy(ỹ)
        for g in panels
            idx = pidx[g]
            ỹ_w[idx] .-= mean(ỹ_w[idx])
            for j in axes(X_pw_w, 2)
                X_pw_w[idx, j] .-= mean(X_pw_w[idx, j])
            end
        end
        β_w = X_pw_w \ ỹ_w
        u_w = ỹ_w .- X_pw_w * β_w
        n_obs = length(ỹ)
        σ2_ε = sum(abs2, u_w) / (n_obs - N - k + 1)

        # Between on PW panel means
        Ts = [length(pidx[g]) for g in panels]
        T̄ = mean(Ts)
        y_b = [mean(ỹ[pidx[g]]) for g in panels]
        X_b = hcat(ones(N),
                   hcat([[mean(X̃[pidx[g], j]) for g in panels]
                         for j in 2:size(X̃, 2)]...))
        β_b = X_b \ y_b
        u_b = y_b .- X_b * β_b
        σ2_1 = sum(abs2, u_b) / (N - k - 1)
        σ2_u = max(σ2_1 - σ2_ε / T̄, 0.0)
        θ = 1 - sqrt(σ2_ε / (T̄ * σ2_u + σ2_ε))

        # θ-demean the PW data
        ỹ_s = copy(ỹ); X̃_s = copy(X̃)
        for g in panels
            idx = pidx[g]
            ym = mean(ỹ[idx])
            ỹ_s[idx] .-= θ * ym
            for j in axes(X̃_s, 2)
                X̃_s[idx, j] .-= θ * mean(X̃[idx, j])
            end
        end
        β_full = X̃_s \ ỹ_s
        u_s = ỹ_s .- X̃_s * β_full
        V = σ2_ε .* inv(X̃_s' * X̃_s)
        se_full = sqrt.(max.(diag(V), 0.0))
        V_full = V
        # reorder: xvars first, constant last
        order = vcat(2:k+1, 1)
        β_full = β_full[order]
        se_full = se_full[order]
        V_full = V_full[order, order]
        cnames = vcat(string.(xvars), "_cons")
    end

    return (; β = β_full, V = V_full, se = se_full,
              coefnames = cnames, n_obs = length(ỹ),
              n_panels = N, ρ = ρ, method)
end

"""
    xtscc(df, yvar, xvars, panelvar, timevar; fe=false, lag=4)

Stata-style `xtscc` — Driscoll-Kraay standard errors for pooled OLS (or FE
within if `fe=true`). Uses a Newey-West HAC estimator on the cross-sectional
sums of moment conditions.
"""
function xtscc(df, yvar::Symbol, xvars::Vector{Symbol},
               panelvar::Symbol, timevar::Symbol;
               fe::Bool = false, lag::Int = 4)
    d = sort(DataFrames.dropmissing(df, vcat([yvar, panelvar, timevar], xvars)),
             [panelvar, timevar])
    y = Float64.(d[!, yvar])
    X = hcat(ones(nrow(d)), hcat([Float64.(d[!, v]) for v in xvars]...))

    if fe
        # Within-transform
        for g in unique(d[!, panelvar])
            idx = findall(==(g), d[!, panelvar])
            y[idx] .-= mean(y[idx])
            for j in axes(X, 2); X[idx, j] .-= mean(X[idx, j]); end
        end
        X_est = X[:, 2:end]   # drop constant (absorbed)
    else
        X_est = X
    end
    k = size(X_est, 2)
    β = X_est \ y
    u = y .- X_est * β
    n = length(y)

    # Driscoll-Kraay: time-based Newey-West on cross-sectional averages
    times = sort(unique(d[!, timevar]))
    TT = length(times)
    tidx = Dict(t => findall(==(t), d[!, timevar]) for t in times)

    # S_t = Σ_i X_it' u_it   (cross-sectional sum at each t)
    S = zeros(TT, k)
    for (ti, t) in enumerate(times)
        idx = tidx[t]
        for j in 1:k
            S[ti, j] = sum(X_est[idx, j] .* u[idx])
        end
    end

    # Newey-West on S
    Γ0 = S' * S / TT
    Ω = copy(Γ0)
    for ℓ in 1:lag
        w = 1 - ℓ / (lag + 1)  # Bartlett kernel
        Γℓ = zeros(k, k)
        for ti in (ℓ+1):TT
            Γℓ += S[ti, :] * S[ti-ℓ, :]'
        end
        Γℓ ./= TT
        Ω .+= w .* (Γℓ .+ Γℓ')
    end
    XtX_inv = inv(X_est' * X_est)
    V = n * XtX_inv * Ω * XtX_inv   # scale by n (as Stata does)
    se = sqrt.(max.(diag(V), 0.0))

    if fe
        # Recover constant
        d2 = sort(DataFrames.dropmissing(df, vcat([yvar, panelvar, timevar], xvars)),
                  [panelvar, timevar])
        pm = DataFrames.combine(DataFrames.groupby(d2, panelvar),
            yvar => (x -> mean(Float64.(x))) => :ym,
            [v => (x -> mean(Float64.(x))) => Symbol(v, :_m) for v in xvars]...)
        cons = mean(pm.ym .- sum(β[j] * pm[!, Symbol(xvars[j], :_m)] for j in 1:k))
        β_full = vcat(β, [cons])
        se_full = vcat(se, [NaN])
        V_full = zeros(k+1, k+1); V_full[1:k, 1:k] = V
        cnames = vcat(string.(xvars), "_cons")
    else
        # reorder: xvars first, constant last (constant is column 1 in X_est)
        order = vcat(2:k, 1)
        β_full = β[order]; se_full = se[order]
        V_full = V[order, order]
        cnames = vcat(string.(xvars), "_cons")
    end
    return (; β = β_full, V = V_full, se = se_full,
              coefnames = cnames, n_obs = n, fe, lag)
end

"""
    hausman_taylor(df, y, idvar; time_exog, time_endog, indiv_exog, indiv_endog)

Stata-style `xthtaylor` — Hausman-Taylor (1981) estimator for panel data with
time-invariant regressors.

Instruments (after θ-transform):
  1. Within-deviations of all time-varying regressors (exog + endog)
  2. Levels of time-invariant exogenous regressors
  3. Group means of time-varying exogenous regressors

Arguments:
  * `y`            : dependent variable (Symbol)
  * `idvar`        : panel identifier (Symbol)
  * `time_exog`    : Vector{Symbol} of time-varying exogenous regressors
  * `time_endog`   : Vector{Symbol} of time-varying endogenous regressors
  * `indiv_exog`   : Vector{Symbol} of time-invariant exogenous regressors
  * `indiv_endog`  : Vector{Symbol} of time-invariant endogenous regressors
"""
function hausman_taylor(df, y::Symbol, idvar::Symbol;
                        time_exog::Vector{Symbol}   = Symbol[],
                        time_endog::Vector{Symbol}  = Symbol[],
                        indiv_exog::Vector{Symbol}  = Symbol[],
                        indiv_endog::Vector{Symbol} = Symbol[],
                        vce::Symbol = :default,      # :default, :bootstrap (cluster)
                        reps::Int = 400,
                        seed::Int = 10101,
                        _ht_coefs_only::Bool = false)   # internal flag
    all_X = vcat(time_exog, time_endog, indiv_exog, indiv_endog)
    needed = unique(vcat([y, idvar], all_X))
    d = DataFrames.dropmissing(df, needed)
    n = DataFrames.nrow(d)
    gdf = DataFrames.groupby(d, idvar)
    N   = length(gdf)
    time_all = vcat(time_exog, time_endog)
    k_tv = length(time_all)                       # number of time-varying regressors

    # ── Panel means for all variables (y + all X) ─────────────────
    means_df = DataFrames.combine(gdf,
        (v => (x -> Statistics.mean(Float64.(_rawval.(collect(skipmissing(x)))))) =>
            Symbol(v, :_bar) for v in vcat([y], all_X))...)
    d2 = DataFrames.leftjoin(d, means_df, on = idvar)

    # ── Step 1: FE within estimator → σ̂²_ε ───────────────────────
    # Manual within-demean to avoid predict/save issues
    ỹ = Float64.(d2[!, y]) .- d2[!, Symbol(y, :_bar)]
    X̃_tv = hcat([Float64.(d2[!, v]) .- d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bar)] for v in time_all]...)
    β_fe = X̃_tv \ ỹ
    e_fe = ỹ .- X̃_tv * β_fe
    T_bar = n / N
    σ_ε2 = sum(abs2, e_fe) / (n - N)       # plm/Stata: no K correction

    # ── Step 2: σ̂²_u via IV on fixed effects (plm "ht" method) ───
    # Individual fixed effects: α̂_i = ȳ_i - X̄_tv_i'β̂_FE
    fe_i = Vector{Float64}(undef, N)
    for (j, g) in enumerate(gdf)
        ȳ = Statistics.mean(Float64.(_rawval.(g[!, y])))
        x̄ = [Statistics.mean(Float64.(_rawval.(g[!, v]))) for v in time_all]
        fe_i[j] = ȳ - LinearAlgebra.dot(x̄, β_fe)
    end

    # Time-invariant variables at group level (N rows)
    indiv_all = vcat(indiv_exog, indiv_endog)
    ti_mat = Matrix{Float64}(undef, N, length(indiv_all))
    for (j, g) in enumerate(gdf)
        for (c, v) in enumerate(indiv_all)
            ti_mat[j, c] = Float64(_rawval(first(g[!, v])))
        end
    end

    # TI-exogenous only (for use as their own instruments)
    ti_exog_mat = Matrix{Float64}(undef, N, length(indiv_exog))
    for (j, g) in enumerate(gdf)
        for (c, v) in enumerate(indiv_exog)
            ti_exog_mat[j, c] = Float64(_rawval(first(g[!, v])))
        end
    end

    # Group means of TV-exog (instruments for TI-endogenous)
    W_fe = Matrix{Float64}(undef, N, length(time_exog))
    for (j, g) in enumerate(gdf)
        for (c, v) in enumerate(time_exog)
            W_fe[j, c] = Statistics.mean(Float64.(_rawval.(g[!, v])))
        end
    end

    # IV regression at group level:
    # Regressors = [1, ti_exog, ti_endog]
    # Instruments = [1, ti_exog (as self-instruments), group_means_TVexog]
    # ti_endog is instrumented by group means of TV_exog (HT requires #TV_exog ≥ #TI_endog)
    ti_mat_c = hcat(ones(N), ti_mat)                          # 1 + k_TI cols
    W_fe_c   = hcat(ones(N), ti_exog_mat, W_fe)               # 1 + k_TIexog + k_TVexog cols
    P_W = W_fe_c * ((W_fe_c'W_fe_c) \ W_fe_c')
    β_ti_full = (ti_mat_c' * P_W * ti_mat_c) \ (ti_mat_c' * P_W * fe_i)
    e_ti = fe_i .- ti_mat_c * β_ti_full
    s21 = sum(abs2, e_ti) / N          # MSE of IV residuals ≈ σ_u² + σ_ε²/T
    σ_u2 = max(s21 - σ_ε2 / T_bar, 0.0)

    # ── Step 3: θ-transform (quasi-demean) ────────────────────────
    θ = 1 - sqrt(σ_ε2 / (T_bar * σ_u2 + σ_ε2))
    for v in vcat([y], all_X)
        d2[!, Symbol(v, :_star)] = Float64.(d2[!, v]) .- θ .* d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bar)]
    end

    # ── Step 4: Build regressors and instruments on θ-transformed data ─
    # Within-deviations of all time-varying variables
    for v in time_all
        d2[!, Symbol(v, :_w)] = Float64.(d2[!, v]) .- d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bar)]
    end
    # Group means of time-varying exogenous
    for v in time_exog
        d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bbar)] = d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bar)]   # already computed
    end

    # Regressors X* = [1*, X1*_star, ..., Xk*_star]
    X_cols = Symbol.(string.(all_X) .* "_star")
    X = hcat(fill(1 - θ, n), Matrix{Float64}(d2[:, X_cols]))  # θ-transformed constant
    y_star = Vector{Float64}(d2[!, Symbol(y, :_star)])

    # Instruments Z = [1*, within-devs of TV, levels of TI-exog, group-means of TV-exog]
    Z_parts = Vector{Matrix{Float64}}()
    push!(Z_parts, fill(1 - θ, n, 1))                         # constant
    # Within-deviations of ALL time-varying regressors
    push!(Z_parts, hcat([Vector{Float64}(d2[!, Symbol(v, :_w)]) for v in time_all]...))
    # Levels of time-invariant exogenous (θ-transformed)
    if !isempty(indiv_exog)
        push!(Z_parts, hcat([Float64.(d2[!, v]) .- θ .* d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bar)]
                             for v in indiv_exog]...))
    end
    # Group means of time-varying exogenous
    if !isempty(time_exog)
        push!(Z_parts, hcat([Vector{Float64}(d2[!, Symbol(v, :_bar)]) for v in time_exog]...))
    end
    Z = hcat(Z_parts...)

    # ── 2SLS: β̂ = (X'P_Z X)⁻¹ X'P_Z y* ─────────────────────────
    P_Z = Z * ((Z'Z) \ Z')
    XPZ = X' * P_Z
    β = (XPZ * X) \ (XPZ * y_star)
    # Analytic variance: use σ²_ε (the θ-transform normalises error variance to σ²_ε)
    V = σ_ε2 .* inv(XPZ * X)

    # Early return for internal bootstrap calls (just the coefficients)
    _ht_coefs_only && return β

    # ── Bootstrap or Jackknife SEs (Stata xthtaylor vce() options) ──
    panel_ids = unique(d[!, idvar])
    id_to_rows = Dict{Any, Vector{Int}}()
    for (i, id) in enumerate(d[!, idvar])
        push!(get!(id_to_rows, id, Int[]), i)
    end

    if vce == :bootstrap
        rng = Random.MersenneTwister(seed)
        boot_β = Matrix{Float64}(undef, 0, length(β))
        n_fail = 0
        for b in 1:reps
            boot_ids = StatsBase.sample(rng, panel_ids, length(panel_ids); replace=true)
            row_idx = Int[]; new_id = Int[]
            for (k, idv) in enumerate(boot_ids)
                rows = id_to_rows[idv]
                append!(row_idx, rows)
                append!(new_id, fill(k, length(rows)))
            end
            sub = d[row_idx, :]
            sub[!, idvar] = new_id
            try
                β_b = hausman_taylor(sub, y, idvar;
                    time_exog=time_exog, time_endog=time_endog,
                    indiv_exog=indiv_exog, indiv_endog=indiv_endog,
                    _ht_coefs_only=true)
                boot_β = vcat(boot_β, β_b')
            catch
                n_fail += 1
            end
        end
        n_fail > 0 && @warn "Bootstrap: $n_fail/$reps resamples failed."
        V  = Statistics.cov(boot_β)
        se = vec(Statistics.std(boot_β, dims=1))
    elseif vce == :jackknife
        # Panel (delete-one-cluster) jackknife: leave each panel out, re-estimate,
        # then V_jack = ((N-1)/N) · Σ (β_{-i} - β̄)(β_{-i} - β̄)'
        nβ = length(β)
        jack_β = Matrix{Float64}(undef, 0, nβ)
        n_fail = 0
        for idv in panel_ids
            sub = d[d[!, idvar] .!= idv, :]
            try
                β_j = hausman_taylor(sub, y, idvar;
                    time_exog=time_exog, time_endog=time_endog,
                    indiv_exog=indiv_exog, indiv_endog=indiv_endog,
                    _ht_coefs_only=true)
                jack_β = vcat(jack_β, β_j')
            catch
                n_fail += 1
            end
        end
        n_fail > 0 && @warn "Jackknife: $n_fail/$N panels produced errors."
        N_used = size(jack_β, 1)
        β_bar  = vec(Statistics.mean(jack_β, dims=1))
        dev    = jack_β .- β_bar'
        V      = ((N_used - 1) / N_used) .* (dev' * dev)
        se     = sqrt.(max.(LinearAlgebra.diag(V), 0.0))
    else
        se = sqrt.(max.(LinearAlgebra.diag(V), 0.0))
    end

    # t or z statistic depending on vce
    use_t = (vce == :jackknife)
    if use_t
        df_t = N - 1               # jackknife df = N panels - 1
        z  = β ./ se
        p  = 2 .* (1 .- Distributions.cdf.(Distributions.TDist(df_t), abs.(z)))
    else
        z  = β ./ se
        p  = 2 .* (1 .- Distributions.cdf.(Distributions.Normal(), abs.(z)))
    end

    # Note: X columns are in order [1, time_exog..., time_endog..., indiv_exog..., indiv_endog...]
    colnames = vcat(["_cons"], string.(all_X))

    σ_u = sqrt(σ_u2);  σ_e = sqrt(σ_ε2)
    ρ   = σ_u2 / (σ_u2 + σ_ε2)

    # ── Wald test on slope coefs (excluding _cons) ──────────────
    β_slope = β[2:end]
    V_slope = V[2:end, 2:end]
    Wald_chi2 = β_slope' * LinearAlgebra.inv(V_slope) * β_slope
    k_slope = length(β_slope)
    if use_t
        # Jackknife: report F(k, N-1) = (Wald / k)
        Wald = Wald_chi2 / k_slope
        Wald_p = 1 - Distributions.cdf(Distributions.FDist(k_slope, N - 1), Wald)
    else
        Wald = Wald_chi2
        Wald_p = 1 - Distributions.cdf(Distributions.Chisq(k_slope), Wald)
    end

    # ── Panel info ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    T_counts = [DataFrames.nrow(g) for g in gdf]
    T_min = minimum(T_counts); T_max_v = maximum(T_counts)

    # ── CI (t-crit for jackknife, z-crit otherwise) ──────────────
    crit = use_t ? Distributions.quantile(Distributions.TDist(N - 1), 0.975) : 1.96
    ci_lo = β .- crit .* se
    ci_hi = β .+ crit .* se

    # ── Stata %9.0g-style number formatter (strip leading 0 for |x|<1) ──
    function g9(x; w::Int=10, sig::Int=7)
        (ismissing(x) || !isfinite(x)) && return lpad(".", w)
        s = Printf.@sprintf("%.*g", sig, x)
        if 0 < abs(x) < 1
            s = replace(s, r"^(-?)0\." => s"\1.")
        end
        return lpad(s, w)
    end
    function commafmt(n)
        s = string(abs(n)); parts = String[]; i = length(s)
        while i >= 1
            push!(parts, s[max(1, i-2):i]); i -= 3
        end
        return (n < 0 ? "-" : "") * join(reverse(parts), ",")
    end

    # ── Index lookup (position in β vector) ──────────────────────
    # β order: [_cons, time_exog..., time_endog..., indiv_exog..., indiv_endog...]
    idx_of = Dict{Symbol,Int}()
    pos = 2
    for v in time_exog;   idx_of[v] = pos; pos += 1; end
    for v in time_endog;  idx_of[v] = pos; pos += 1; end
    for v in indiv_exog;  idx_of[v] = pos; pos += 1; end
    for v in indiv_endog; idx_of[v] = pos; pos += 1; end

    # ── Print Stata-format output ────────────────────────────────
    println()
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10s\n",
                   "Hausman-Taylor estimation", "Number of obs", commafmt(n))
    Printf.@printf("Group variable: %-32s%-18s= %10d\n",
                   string(idvar), "Number of groups", N)
    println()
    println("                                                Obs per group:")
    Printf.@printf("%48s%-5s = %10d\n", "", "min", T_min)
    Printf.@printf("%48s%-5s = %10d\n", "", "avg", round(Int, T_bar))
    Printf.@printf("%48s%-5s = %10d\n", "", "max", T_max_v)
    println()
    if use_t
        Printf.@printf("Random effects u_i ~ i.i.d.%21sF(%3d, %6d)   = %10.2f\n",
                       "", k_slope, N - 1, Wald)
        Printf.@printf("%48sProb > F          = %10.4f\n", "", Wald_p)
    else
        Printf.@printf("Random effects u_i ~ i.i.d.%21sWald chi2(%d)     = %10.2f\n",
                       "", k_slope, Wald)
        Printf.@printf("%48sProb > chi2       = %10.4f\n", "", Wald_p)
    end
    println()
    if vce == :bootstrap
        Printf.@printf("%79s\n", "(Replications based on $N clusters in $idvar)")
    elseif vce == :jackknife
        Printf.@printf("%79s\n", "(Replications based on $N clusters in $idvar)")
    end
    println("-"^78)
    if vce == :bootstrap
        println("             |   Observed   Bootstrap                         Normal-based")
        Printf.@printf("%12s | coefficient  std. err.      z    P>|z|     [95%% conf. interval]\n",
                       string(y))
    elseif vce == :jackknife
        println("             |              Jackknife")
        Printf.@printf("%12s | Coefficient  std. err.      t    P>|t|     [95%% conf. interval]\n",
                       string(y))
    else
        Printf.@printf("%12s | Coefficient  Std. err.      z    P>|z|     [95%% conf. interval]\n",
                       string(y))
    end
    println("-"^13, "+", "-"^64)

    # Helper: print one coefficient row
    function prow(v::Symbol)
        i = idx_of[v]
        Printf.@printf("%12s | %s  %s  %s   %s    %s  %s\n",
                       string(v),
                       g9(β[i]; w=10), g9(se[i]; w=9),
                       Printf.@sprintf("%6.2f", z[i]),
                       Printf.@sprintf("%.3f", p[i]),
                       g9(ci_lo[i]; w=10), g9(ci_hi[i]; w=10))
    end

    # Sections (only print if non-empty)
    if !isempty(time_exog)
        println("TVexogenous  |")
        for v in time_exog;  prow(v);  end
    end
    if !isempty(time_endog)
        println("TVendogenous |")
        for v in time_endog; prow(v);  end
    end
    if !isempty(indiv_exog)
        println("TIexogenous  |")
        for v in indiv_exog; prow(v);  end
    end
    if !isempty(indiv_endog)
        println("TIendogenous |")
        for v in indiv_endog; prow(v); end
    end
    println("             |")
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s  %s  %s   %s    %s  %s\n",
                   "_cons",
                   g9(β[1]; w=10), g9(se[1]; w=9),
                   Printf.@sprintf("%6.2f", z[1]),
                   Printf.@sprintf("%.3f", p[1]),
                   g9(ci_lo[1]; w=10), g9(ci_hi[1]; w=10))
    println("-"^13, "+", "-"^64)
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s\n", "sigma_u", g9(σ_u; w=10))
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s\n", "sigma_e", g9(σ_e; w=10))
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s   (fraction of variance due to u_i)\n",
                   "rho", g9(ρ; w=10))
    println("-"^78)
    println("Note: TV refers to time varying; TI refers to time invariant.")

    return (; β, V, se, z, p, ci_lo, ci_hi,
              coefnames = colnames, σ_ε2, σ_u2, σ_u, σ_e, ρ, θ, n,
              Wald, Wald_p, nobs=n, N_panels=N,
              T_min, T_avg=round(Int, T_bar), T_max=T_max_v)
end

"""
    arellano_bond(df, y, idvar, timevar; lags=1, xvars=Symbol[], twostep=false)

Arellano-Bond (1991) difference GMM for a dynamic linear panel model:

    y_{it} = ρ₁ y_{i,t-1} + ... + ρ_p y_{i,t-p} + X_{it}'β + αᵢ + ε_{it}

After first-differencing, instruments for Δy_{i,t-k} are all available lags
of y at t-k-1 or earlier (assuming E[ε_{it} y_{i,t-s}] = 0 for s ≥ k+1).

Arguments:
  * `lags`    : p, number of lags of y (default 1)
  * `xvars`   : additional strictly exogenous regressors (Vector{Symbol})
  * `twostep` : use the two-step efficient weighting (default one-step)
"""
function arellano_bond(df, y::Symbol, idvar::Symbol, timevar::Symbol;
                       lags::Int=1, xvars::Vector{Symbol}=Symbol[],
                       twostep::Bool=false, maxldep::Int=0,
                       pre::Vector{Tuple{Symbol,Int,Int}}=Tuple{Symbol,Int,Int}[],
                       endog::Vector{Tuple{Symbol,Int,Int}}=Tuple{Symbol,Int,Int}[])
    # ── Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    all_syms = unique(vcat([y, idvar, timevar], xvars,
                           [v for (v,_,_) in pre], [v for (v,_,_) in endog]))
    d = DataFrames.sort(DataFrames.dropmissing(df, all_syms), [idvar, timevar])
    grouped = DataFrames.groupby(d, idvar)
    N_groups = length(grouped)

    # Number of regressor columns (no constant)
    n_pre_regs   = sum(a + 1 for (_,a,_) in pre;   init=0)
    n_endog_regs = sum(a + 1 for (_,a,_) in endog;  init=0)
    k_reg = lags + n_pre_regs + n_endog_regs + length(xvars)

    # ── GMM instrument groups: (variable, offset, depth) ──────────
    # offset = minimum lag for a valid level instrument
    # depth  = max number of lagged levels per period
    gmm_groups = Tuple{Symbol, Int, Int}[]
    push!(gmm_groups, (y, lags, maxldep > 0 ? maxldep : 999))
    for (v, a, b) in pre;    push!(gmm_groups, (v, a + 1, b));  end
    for (v, a, b) in endog;  push!(gmm_groups, (v, a + 2, b));  end

    # ── Instrument column layout (from longest panel) ─────────────
    # First-differenced AR(lags) model uses equations starting at t = lags+2
    # (need y_{t-lags-1} available to form Δy_{t-lags}).
    t_start = lags + 2
    T_max = maximum(DataFrames.nrow(g) for g in grouped)
    n_periods = max(0, T_max - t_start + 1)
    # per-period (col_start, n_cols) for each GMM group
    period_info = Vector{Vector{Tuple{Int,Int}}}(undef, n_periods)
    col = 1
    for (pidx, t) in enumerate(t_start:T_max)
        info = Tuple{Int,Int}[]
        for (_, s, depth) in gmm_groups
            n_inst = max(0, min(depth, t - s))
            push!(info, (col, n_inst))
            col += n_inst
        end
        period_info[pidx] = info
    end
    gmm_ncol = col - 1
    n_z = gmm_ncol + length(xvars)          # GMM + standard Δxvars

    # ── Build per-panel arrays (no constant in X or Z) ────────────
    panel_dy = Vector{Vector{Float64}}()
    panel_dx = Vector{Matrix{Float64}}()
    panel_zi = Vector{Matrix{Float64}}()
    T_vals   = Int[]

    for g in grouped
        T_i = DataFrames.nrow(g)
        n_use = max(0, T_i - t_start + 1)   # obs = {t_start, ..., T_i}
        n_use < 1 && continue
        y_v = collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, y]))
        pre_vecs   = [collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, v])) for (v,_,_) in pre]
        endog_vecs = [collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, v])) for (v,_,_) in endog]
        xvar_vecs  = [collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, v])) for v in xvars]
        all_gmm_vecs = vcat([y_v], pre_vecs, endog_vecs)

        dy_i = zeros(n_use)
        dx_i = zeros(n_use, k_reg)
        zi_i = zeros(n_use, n_z)

        for (row, t) in enumerate(t_start:T_i)
            dy_i[row] = y_v[t] - y_v[t-1]

            # ─ Regressor columns (all first-differenced) ─────────
            # Bounds check: Δv_{t-k} = v_{t-k} - v_{t-k-1} requires t-k-1 ≥ 1
            c = 0
            for k in 1:lags
                c += 1
                dx_i[row, c] = (t-k-1 >= 1) ? y_v[t-k] - y_v[t-k-1] : 0.0
            end
            for (pi, (_, a, _)) in enumerate(pre)
                for k in 0:a
                    c += 1
                    dx_i[row, c] = (t-k-1 >= 1) ? pre_vecs[pi][t-k] - pre_vecs[pi][t-k-1] : 0.0
                end
            end
            for (ei, (_, a, _)) in enumerate(endog)
                for k in 0:a
                    c += 1
                    dx_i[row, c] = (t-k-1 >= 1) ? endog_vecs[ei][t-k] - endog_vecs[ei][t-k-1] : 0.0
                end
            end
            for xi in eachindex(xvars)
                c += 1
                dx_i[row, c] = (t-1 >= 1) ? xvar_vecs[xi][t] - xvar_vecs[xi][t-1] : 0.0
            end

            # ─ GMM instruments (block-diagonal) ──────────────────
            pidx = t - t_start + 1
            for (gi, (_, s, _)) in enumerate(gmm_groups)
                cs, n_inst = period_info[pidx][gi]
                for j in 1:n_inst
                    idx_src = t - s - n_inst + j
                    zi_i[row, cs + j - 1] = (idx_src >= 1) ? all_gmm_vecs[gi][idx_src] : 0.0
                end
            end

            # ─ Standard instruments: Δxvars ──────────────────────
            for xi in eachindex(xvars)
                zi_i[row, gmm_ncol + xi] = (t-1 >= 1) ? xvar_vecs[xi][t] - xvar_vecs[xi][t-1] : 0.0
            end
        end
        push!(panel_dy, dy_i);  push!(panel_dx, dx_i)
        push!(panel_zi, zi_i);  push!(T_vals, n_use)
    end
    isempty(panel_dy) && error("No usable observations for Arellano-Bond.")

    yvec = vcat(panel_dy...)
    Xmat = vcat(panel_dx...)
    Zmat_raw = vcat(panel_zi...)

    # Drop all-zero instrument columns (Stata omits unavailable instruments)
    nz_cols = findall(c -> any(!iszero, Zmat_raw[:, c]), 1:size(Zmat_raw, 2))
    Zmat = Zmat_raw[:, nz_cols]
    # Remap panel_zi to the same reduced column set
    panel_zi = [zi[:, nz_cols] for zi in panel_zi]
    n_z = size(Zmat, 2)

    N_obs = length(yvec)
    N_ind = length(panel_dy)

    # ── One-step weight: W₁ = pinv(Σᵢ Zᵢ'HᵢZᵢ) ─────────────────
    ZHZ = zeros(n_z, n_z)
    for i in 1:N_ind
        Ti = T_vals[i]
        Hi = zeros(Ti, Ti)
        for r in 1:Ti
            Hi[r, r] = 2.0
            r < Ti && (Hi[r, r+1] = -1.0)
            r > 1  && (Hi[r, r-1] = -1.0)
        end
        ZHZ .+= panel_zi[i]' * Hi * panel_zi[i]
    end
    W1 = LinearAlgebra.pinv(ZHZ)
    XZ = Xmat' * Zmat
    β1 = (XZ * W1 * XZ') \ (XZ * W1 * Zmat' * yvec)

    β = β1
    if twostep
        # Step 2: update weight matrix using one-step residuals
        u1 = yvec .- Xmat * β1
        Ω1 = zeros(n_z, n_z);  offset = 0
        for i in 1:N_ind
            Ti = T_vals[i];  ui = u1[offset+1:offset+Ti]
            Ω1 .+= panel_zi[i]' * (ui * ui') * panel_zi[i]
            offset += Ti
        end
        W2 = LinearAlgebra.pinv(Ω1)
        β = (XZ * W2 * XZ') \ (XZ * W2 * Zmat' * yvec)

        # Standard two-step cluster-robust sandwich
        u2 = yvec .- Xmat * β
        Ω2 = zeros(n_z, n_z);  off2 = 0
        for i in 1:N_ind
            Ti = T_vals[i];  ui = u2[off2+1:off2+Ti]
            Ω2 .+= panel_zi[i]' * (ui * ui') * panel_zi[i]
            off2 += Ti
        end
        A2 = XZ * W2 * XZ'
        A2inv = LinearAlgebra.inv(A2)
        V2_robust = A2inv * (XZ * W2 * Ω2 * W2 * XZ') * A2inv

        # ── Windmeijer (2005) finite-sample correction ──
        # V_W = V₂ + D·V₂ + V₂·D' + D·V₁·D'
        # where D[:,k] = A₂⁻¹ · (X'Z) · W₂ · (∂Ω₁/∂β₁_k) · W₂ · Z'û₂
        #       ∂Ω₁/∂β₁_k = -2 Σᵢ (xᵢₖ · u₁ᵢ) · zᵢzᵢ'
        A1 = XZ * W1 * XZ'
        A1inv = LinearAlgebra.inv(A1)
        V1_robust = A1inv * (XZ * W1 * Ω1 * W1 * XZ') * A1inv

        Zpu2 = Zmat' * u2
        a_vec = W2 * Zpu2
        c_vec = Zmat * a_vec                       # length N_obs
        M     = A2inv * (XZ * W2) * Zmat'           # k_reg × N_obs
        weight = u1 .* c_vec
        D     = -2.0 .* M * LinearAlgebra.Diagonal(weight) * Xmat

        Vβ = V2_robust + D * V2_robust + V2_robust * D' + D * V1_robust * D'
    else
        u = yvec .- Xmat * β
        Ω = zeros(n_z, n_z);  offset = 0
        for i in 1:N_ind
            Ti = T_vals[i];  ui = u[offset+1:offset+Ti]
            Ω .+= panel_zi[i]' * (ui * ui') * panel_zi[i]
            offset += Ti
        end
        A = XZ * W1 * XZ'
        Ainv = LinearAlgebra.inv(A)
        Vβ = Ainv * (XZ * W1 * Ω * W1 * XZ') * Ainv
    end

    # ── Recover constant from level equation ──────────────────────
    y_sum = 0.0;  yl_sum = zeros(k_reg);  n_lev = 0
    for g in grouped
        T_i = DataFrames.nrow(g);  T_i < lags + 1 && continue
        y_v = collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, y]))
        pre_vecs   = [collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, v])) for (v,_,_) in pre]
        endog_vecs = [collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, v])) for (v,_,_) in endog]
        xvar_vecs  = [collect(Float64, map(_rawval, g[!, v])) for v in xvars]
        for t in (lags+1):T_i
            y_sum += y_v[t]
            c = 0
            for k in 1:lags;  c += 1;  yl_sum[c] += y_v[t-k];  end
            for (pi, (_, a, _)) in enumerate(pre)
                for k in 0:a;  c += 1;  yl_sum[c] += pre_vecs[pi][t-k];  end
            end
            for (ei, (_, a, _)) in enumerate(endog)
                for k in 0:a;  c += 1;  yl_sum[c] += endog_vecs[ei][t-k];  end
            end
            for xi in eachindex(xvars);  c += 1;  yl_sum[c] += xvar_vecs[xi][t];  end
            n_lev += 1
        end
    end
    ȳ = y_sum / n_lev
    x̄_lev = yl_sum ./ n_lev
    β_cons = ȳ - LinearAlgebra.dot(β, x̄_lev)
    se_cons = sqrt(x̄_lev' * Vβ * x̄_lev)

    # ── Augmented coefficient vector with constant appended ───────
    β_full = vcat(β, β_cons)
    V_full = zeros(k_reg + 1, k_reg + 1)
    V_full[1:k_reg, 1:k_reg] .= Vβ
    g_cons = -x̄_lev
    V_full[end, end] = se_cons^2
    cov_β_cons = vec(Vβ * g_cons)
    V_full[1:k_reg, end] .= cov_β_cons
    V_full[end, 1:k_reg] .= cov_β_cons

    se = sqrt.(max.(LinearAlgebra.diag(V_full), 0.0))
    z  = β_full ./ se
    pv = 2 .* (1 .- Distributions.cdf.(Distributions.Normal(), abs.(z)))

    # Wald chi2 on ALL slope coefficients (excl _cons)
    wald = β' * LinearAlgebra.inv(Vβ) * β
    wald_p = 1 - Distributions.cdf(Distributions.Chisq(k_reg), wald)

    n_instruments = n_z + 1   # +1 for _cons in level equation

    # ── Coefficient names ─────────────────────────────────────────
    colnames = String[]
    for k in 1:lags;  push!(colnames, "L$(k).$(y)");  end
    for (v, a, _) in pre
        for k in 0:a;  push!(colnames, k == 0 ? string(v) : "L$(k).$(v)");  end
    end
    for (v, a, _) in endog
        for k in 0:a;  push!(colnames, k == 0 ? string(v) : "L$(k).$(v)");  end
    end
    for v in xvars;  push!(colnames, string(v));  end
    push!(colnames, "_cons")

    step_lbl = twostep ? "Two-step" : "One-step"
    T_avg = N_obs / N_ind
    T_min = minimum(T_vals);  T_max_v = maximum(T_vals)

    ci_lo = β_full .- 1.96 .* se
    ci_hi = β_full .+ 1.96 .* se

    # ── Stata %9.0g-style formatter (strip leading 0 for |x|<1) ──
    function g9(x; w::Int=10, sig::Int=7)
        (ismissing(x) || !isfinite(x)) && return lpad(".", w)
        s = Printf.@sprintf("%.*g", sig, x)
        if 0 < abs(x) < 1
            s = replace(s, r"^(-?)0\." => s"\1.")
        end
        return lpad(s, w)
    end
    function commafmt(m)
        s = string(abs(m)); parts = String[]; i = length(s)
        while i >= 1
            push!(parts, s[max(1, i-2):i]); i -= 3
        end
        return (m < 0 ? "-" : "") * join(reverse(parts), ",")
    end

    # ── Print Stata-style output ──────────────────────────────────
    println()
    Printf.@printf("%-48s%-18s= %10s\n",
                   "Arellano-Bond dynamic panel-data estimation",
                   "Number of obs", commafmt(N_obs))
    Printf.@printf("Group variable: %-32s%-18s= %10d\n",
                   string(idvar), "Number of groups", N_ind)
    Printf.@printf("Time variable: %s\n", string(timevar))
    println("                                                Obs per group:")
    Printf.@printf("%48s%-5s = %10d\n", "", "min", T_min)
    Printf.@printf("%48s%-5s = %10d\n", "", "avg", round(Int, T_avg))
    Printf.@printf("%48s%-5s = %10d\n", "", "max", T_max_v)
    println()
    Printf.@printf("Number of instruments = %6d%18sWald chi2(%d)      = %10.2f\n",
                   n_instruments, "", k_reg, wald)
    Printf.@printf("%48sProb > chi2       = %10.4f\n", "", wald_p)
    println("$(step_lbl) results")
    Printf.@printf("%79s\n", "(Std. err. adjusted for clustering on $(string(idvar)))")
    println("-"^78)
    if twostep
        println("             |              WC-robust")
    else
        println("             |               Robust")
    end
    Printf.@printf("%12s | Coefficient  std. err.      z    P>|z|     [95%% conf. interval]\n",
                   string(y))
    println("-"^13, "+", "-"^64)

    # Helper to print a coefficient row with arbitrary label in left column
    function prow(label::String, i::Int)
        Printf.@printf("%12s | %s  %s  %s   %s    %s  %s\n",
                       label,
                       g9(β_full[i]; w=10), g9(se[i]; w=9),
                       Printf.@sprintf("%6.2f", z[i]),
                       Printf.@sprintf("%.3f", pv[i]),
                       g9(ci_lo[i]; w=10), g9(ci_hi[i]; w=10))
    end

    # Group rows: lags of y under "y |", then pre/endog vars as their own
    # groups, then xvars (flat), then _cons
    idx = 1
    if lags > 0
        Printf.@printf("%12s |\n", string(y))
        for k in 1:lags
            prow("L$(k).", idx);  idx += 1
        end
        println("             |")
    end
    for (v, a, _) in pre
        Printf.@printf("%12s |\n", string(v))
        for k in 0:a
            lbl = k == 0 ? "--." : "L$(k)."
            prow(lbl, idx);  idx += 1
        end
        println("             |")
    end
    for (v, a, _) in endog
        Printf.@printf("%12s |\n", string(v))
        for k in 0:a
            lbl = k == 0 ? "--." : "L$(k)."
            prow(lbl, idx);  idx += 1
        end
        println("             |")
    end
    for v in xvars
        prow(string(v), idx);  idx += 1
    end
    prow("_cons", length(β_full))
    println("-"^78)

    # ── Instrument labels ─────────────────────────────────────────
    println("Instruments for differenced equation")
    gmm_labels = String[]
    maxlag_y = maxldep > 0 ? string(lags + maxldep - 1) : "."
    push!(gmm_labels, "L($(lags)/$(maxlag_y)).$(y)")
    for (v, a, b) in pre
        lag_pref = a > 0 ? "L$(a > 1 ? string(a) : "")." : ""
        push!(gmm_labels, "L(1/$(b)).$(lag_pref)$(v)")
    end
    for (v, a, b) in endog
        lag_pref = a > 0 ? "L$(a > 1 ? string(a) : "")." : ""
        push!(gmm_labels, "L(2/$(1+b)).$(lag_pref)$(v)")
    end
    println("        GMM-type: ", join(gmm_labels, " "))
    if !isempty(xvars)
        println("        Standard: ", join(["D." * string(v) for v in xvars], " "))
    end
    println("Instruments for level equation")
    println("        Standard: _cons")

    W_est = twostep ? W2 : W1           # weighting matrix actually used in estimation
    return (; β=β_full, V=V_full, coefnames=colnames,
              residuals=yvec .- Xmat*β,
              Zmat, Xmat, y=yvec, twostep, W=W_est,
              panel_zi, panel_dy, T_vals, N_obs, N_ind)
end

"""
    xtgls_stata(df, y, xvars; panelvar, timevar,
                panels=:correlated, corr=:psar1, level=0.95)

Stata-equivalent `xtgls` for balanced panels. Replicates

    xtset <panelvar> <timevar>
    xtgls <y> <xvars>, panels(<panels>) corr(<corr>)

Supported options:
- `panels`:  `:iid`, `:heteroskedastic`, `:correlated` (default)
- `corr`:    `:independent`, `:ar1`, `:psar1` (default)

Prints a Stata-style header + coefficient table and returns a NamedTuple with
fields `β`, `V`, `se`, `z`, `p`, `coefnames`, `n_obs`, `N_panels`, `T_periods`,
`ρ`, `Wald`, `Wald_p`, `panels`, `corr`, `y_name`.
"""
function xtgls_stata(df, y, xvars; panelvar::Symbol, timevar::Symbol,
                    panels::Symbol=:correlated, corr::Symbol=:psar1,
                    level::Float64=0.95)
    ys  = Symbol(y)
    xsv = [Symbol(v) for v in xvars]
    dfs = sort(df, [panelvar, timevar])
    pan = sort(unique(dfs[!, panelvar]))
    N   = length(pan)
    n   = DataFrames.nrow(dfs)
    T   = n ÷ N

    yv = Float64.(dfs[!, ys])
    X  = hcat(ones(n), hcat([Float64.(dfs[!, v]) for v in xsv]...))
    k  = size(X, 2)
    pidx = [((i-1)*T+1):(i*T) for i in 1:N]

    # Step 1: OLS residuals → AR(1) coefficients (Stata's rhotype=regress).
    # Note: do NOT clamp ρ — Stata allows |ρ| ≥ 1 (explosive AR1). The PW
    # first-obs weight below uses max(1-ρ², 0) which handles |ρ| ≥ 1 by
    # zeroing that panel's first observation.
    e0 = yv - X * (X \ yv)
    ρ = if corr == :independent
        zeros(N)
    elseif corr == :ar1
        num = sum(LinearAlgebra.dot(e0[pidx[i]][2:end], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) for i in 1:N)
        den = sum(LinearAlgebra.dot(e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) for i in 1:N)
        fill(num/den, N)
    elseif corr == :psar1
        [LinearAlgebra.dot(e0[pidx[i]][2:end], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) /
         LinearAlgebra.dot(e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1])
         for i in 1:N]
    else
        error("Unknown corr: $corr (use :independent, :ar1, or :psar1)")
    end

    # Step 2: Prais-Winsten transformation (if any ρ ≠ 0)
    ỹ = copy(yv); X̃ = copy(X)
    if any(!=(0.0), ρ)
        for i in 1:N
            idx = pidx[i]
            s = sqrt(max(1 - ρ[i]^2, 0.0))    # = 0 when |ρ| ≥ 1
            ỹ[idx[1]]    = s * yv[idx[1]]
            X̃[idx[1], :] = s * X[idx[1], :]
            for t in 2:T
                ỹ[idx[t]]    = yv[idx[t]] - ρ[i] * yv[idx[t-1]]
                X̃[idx[t], :] = X[idx[t], :] - ρ[i] * X[idx[t-1], :]
            end
        end
    end

    # Step 3: Cross-sectional/heteroskedastic covariance from residuals of an
    # OLS fit on the PW-transformed data.  Stata drops the first observation
    # per panel from Σ̂ when corr is ar1/psar1 (to remove the PW first-obs
    # heteroskedasticity), and uses divisor = number of obs used in Σ̂.
    e_pw      = ỹ - X̃ * (X̃ \ ỹ)
    drop_first = corr != :independent
    idx_Σ(i) = drop_first ? pidx[i][2:end] : pidx[i]
    T_eff = drop_first ? (T - 1) : T          # effective T used in Σ̂ estimation
    Σ_inv = if panels == :iid
        denom = drop_first ? (n - N - k) : (n - k)
        σ2    = sum(abs2, vcat([e_pw[idx_Σ(i)] for i in 1:N]...)) / max(denom, 1)
        Matrix{Float64}(LinearAlgebra.I(N) ./ σ2)
    elseif panels == :heteroskedastic
        σ2_i = [sum(abs2, e_pw[idx_Σ(i)]) / T_eff for i in 1:N]
        Matrix{Float64}(LinearAlgebra.Diagonal(1.0 ./ σ2_i))
    elseif panels == :correlated
        E = hcat([e_pw[idx_Σ(i)] for i in 1:N]...)    # T_eff × N
        # Stata uses divisor = T_eff (number of rows in E), not T.
        LinearAlgebra.inv(E' * E / T_eff)
    else
        error("Unknown panels: $panels (use :iid, :heteroskedastic, :correlated)")
    end

    # Step 4: GLS with Ω⁻¹ = Σ⁻¹ ⊗ I_T, applied time-period-by-time-period
    XΩX = zeros(k, k); XΩy = zeros(k)
    for t in 1:T
        rows = [(i-1)*T + t for i in 1:N]
        Xt = X̃[rows, :]; yt = ỹ[rows]
        XΩX += Xt' * Σ_inv * Xt
        XΩy += Xt' * Σ_inv * yt
    end
    β  = XΩX \ XΩy
    V  = LinearAlgebra.inv(XΩX)
    se = sqrt.(max.(LinearAlgebra.diag(V), 0.0))
    z  = β ./ se
    pv = 2 .* (1 .- Distributions.cdf.(Distributions.Normal(), abs.(z)))
    zcrit = Distributions.quantile(Distributions.Normal(), 1 - (1-level)/2)
    ci_lo = β .- zcrit .* se
    ci_hi = β .+ zcrit .* se

    Wald   = β[2:end]' * LinearAlgebra.inv(V[2:end, 2:end]) * β[2:end]
    Wald_p = 1 - Distributions.cdf(Distributions.Chisq(k-1), Wald)

    ncov = panels == :iid             ? 1        :
           panels == :heteroskedastic ? N        :
                                        N*(N+1) ÷ 2
    nρ   = corr == :independent ? 0 :
           corr == :ar1         ? 1 :
                                  N         # psar1

    coefnames = ["(Intercept)"; string.(xsv)]

    # Stata %9.0g-style formatter (strip leading 0 for |x|<1)
    function _g(x, w; sig=7)
        (ismissing(x) || !isfinite(x)) && return Printf.@sprintf("%*s", w, ".")
        s = Printf.@sprintf("%.*g", sig, x)
        if 0 < abs(x) < 1
            s = replace(s, r"^(-?)0\." => s"\1.")
        end
        return Printf.@sprintf("%*s", w, s)
    end

    panel_desc = panels == :iid             ? "homoskedastic" :
                 panels == :heteroskedastic ? "heteroskedastic" :
                                              "heteroskedastic with cross-sectional correlation"
    corr_desc  = corr == :independent ? "no autocorrelation" :
                 corr == :ar1         ? "common AR(1)"       :
                                        "panel-specific AR(1)"

    println()
    println("Cross-sectional time-series FGLS regression")
    println()
    println("Coefficients:  generalized least squares")
    println("Panels:        ", panel_desc)
    println("Correlation:   ", corr_desc)
    println()
    Printf.@printf("Estimated covariances      = %9d          Number of obs     = %10d\n",
                   ncov, n)
    Printf.@printf("Estimated autocorrelations = %9d          Number of groups  = %10d\n",
                   nρ, N)
    Printf.@printf("Estimated coefficients     = %9d          Time periods      = %10d\n",
                   k, T)
    wlabel = Printf.@sprintf("Wald chi2(%d)", k-1)
    Printf.@printf("%s%-18s= %10.2f\n", " "^48, wlabel, Wald)
    Printf.@printf("%sProb > chi2       = %10.4f\n", " "^48, Wald_p)
    println()

    println("-"^78)
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %10s  %9s  %6s  %5s     [%d%% conf. interval]\n",
                   string(ys), "Coefficient", "Std. err.", "z", "P>|z|",
                   round(Int, 100*level))
    println("-"^13, "+", "-"^64)
    for j in 2:k
        Printf.@printf("%12s | %s  %s  %6.2f  %5.3f  %s  %s\n",
                       string(xsv[j-1]), _g(β[j],10), _g(se[j],9),
                       z[j], pv[j], _g(ci_lo[j],11), _g(ci_hi[j],11))
    end
    Printf.@printf("%12s | %s  %s  %6.2f  %5.3f  %s  %s\n",
                   "_cons", _g(β[1],10), _g(se[1],9),
                   z[1], pv[1], _g(ci_lo[1],11), _g(ci_hi[1],11))
    println("-"^78)

    return (β=β, V=V, se=se, z=z, p=pv, coefnames=coefnames,
            n_obs=n, N_panels=N, T_periods=T, ρ=ρ,
            Wald=Wald, Wald_p=Wald_p, panels=panels, corr=corr, y_name=ys)
end

function panel_autocor(df, var::Symbol, idvar::Symbol, timevar::Symbol, lag::Int)
    d = DataFrames.sort(df, [idvar, timevar])
    lagcol = Symbol(var, "_L", lag)
    d = DataFrames.transform(DataFrames.groupby(d, idvar),
        var => (x -> vcat(fill(missing, lag), collect(x)[1:end-lag])) => lagcol)
    d = DataFrames.dropmissing(d, [var, lagcol])
    return Statistics.cor(Float64.(d[!, var]), Float64.(d[!, lagcol]))
end
```

```{julia}
=#
```

```{julia}
# First-order autocorrelation, by year
df8_al = DataFrames.transform(DataFrames.groupby(
    DataFrames.sort(df8, [:id, :t]), :id),
    :uhat => (x -> [missing; collect(x)[1:end-1]]) => :uhat_lag1)

    sub = DataFrames.dropmissing(filter(r -> r.t == s, df8_al), :uhat_lag1)
    if DataFrames.nrow(sub) > 1
        Printf.@printf("Autocorrelation at lag 1 in year %d = %6.3f\n",
                       s, Statistics.cor(sub.uhat, sub.uhat_lag1))
    end
end
```

```{julia}
# ed is time-invariant, so FE absorbs it. Inside FixedEffectModels.jl that column
```

```{julia}
#=
* LSDV model fit using factor variables with cluster-robust standard errors
set matsize 800
quietly regress lwage exp exp2 wks ed i.id, vce(cluster id)
estimates table, keep(exp exp2 wks ed _cons) b se b(%12.7f)
=#
# Treat id as categorical so FixedEffectModels expands it into 594 dummies
# (one panel dropped as the base, exactly like Stata's `i.id`).
df_lsdv        = copy(df8)
df_lsdv.id_fac = CategoricalArrays.categorical(df_lsdv.id)

m_lsdv = FixedEffectModels.reg(df_lsdv,
    @formula(lwage ~ exp + exp2 + wks + ed + id_fac),
    Vcov.cluster(:id))

# Filter out NaN rows/cols (collinear dummies) and relabel "(Intercept)" → "_cons".
β_all  = StatsBase.coef(m_lsdv)
V_all  = StatsBase.vcov(m_lsdv)
cn_all = string.(StatsBase.coefnames(m_lsdv))
ok     = findall(i -> isfinite(β_all[i]) && isfinite(V_all[i, i]),
                 eachindex(β_all))
β      = β_all[ok]
V      = replace(V_all[ok, ok], NaN => 0.0, Inf => 0.0, -Inf => 0.0)
se     = sqrt.(max.(LinearAlgebra.diag(V), 0.0))
cn     = replace.(cn_all[ok], "(Intercept)" => "_cons")

fit_lsdv = (; β, V, se, coefnames = cn, n = Int(StatsBase.nobs(m_lsdv)))

# estimates table, keep(exp exp2 wks ed _cons) b se b(%12.7f)
estimates_compare([fit_lsdv], ["Active"];
                  vars_order = ["exp", "exp2", "wks", "ed", "_cons"],
                  fmt        = "%12.7f")
```

```{julia}
#=
// Following gives heteroskedasrtic-robust se's for between estimator
xtreg lwage exp exp2 wks ed, be vce(boot, reps(400) seed(10101) nodots)
=#
# xtreg lwage exp exp2 wks ed, be vce(boot, reps(400) seed(10101) nodots)
# Cluster bootstrap on id for heteroskedasticity-robust SEs of the BE estimator.
# Each bootstrap replicate resamples panels, then re-aggregates to panel means
# and refits OLS on those means.
β_be_mat = panel_bootstrap(df8, :id; B=400, seed=10101) do sub
    means = DataFrames.combine(DataFrames.groupby(sub, :id),
        :lwage => Statistics.mean => :lwage,
        :exp   => Statistics.mean => :exp,
        :exp2  => Statistics.mean => :exp2,
        :wks   => Statistics.mean => :wks,
        :ed    => Statistics.mean => :ed)
    StatsBase.coef(FixedEffectModels.reg(means,
        @formula(lwage ~ exp + exp2 + wks + ed)))
end

boot_regtable(StatsBase.coef(m_be), β_be_mat;
    coefnames = StatsBase.coefnames(m_be),
    title = "Between estimator (xtreg lwage exp exp2 wks ed, be vce(boot))");
```

#### Robust Hausman test

```{julia}
#=
* Robust Hausman test using method of Wooldridge (2002)
quietly xtreg lwage $xlist, re
scalar theta = e(theta)
global yandxforhausman lwage exp exp2 wks ed
sort id
foreach x of varlist $yandxforhausman {
  by id: egen mean`x' = mean(`x')
  generate md`x' = `x' - mean`x'
  generate red`x' = `x' - theta*mean`x'
  }
quietly regress redlwage redexp redexp2 redwks reded mdexp mdexp2 mdwks, vce(cluster id)
test mdexp mdexp2 mdwks
=#
# Robust Hausman test (Wooldridge 2002):
# regress within-demeaned y on within-demeaned x AND x̃ (partial-demeaned), test x̃=0
# Use θ̂ from the MixedModels RE fit.
θ = m_re_h.θ   # Swamy-Arora θ from xtreg_re (matches Stata)
Printf.@printf("Estimated θ = %.4f\n", θ)

# Build within-demeaned and θ-demeaned variables for the Wooldridge auxiliary
df8_w = DataFrames.transform(DataFrames.groupby(df8, :id),
    [:lwage, :exp, :exp2, :wks, :ed] .=>
        (x -> (xm = Statistics.mean(Float64.(_rawval.(collect(skipmissing(x)))));
               Float64.(x) .- xm)) .=>
        [:mdlwage, :mdexp, :mdexp2, :mdwks, :mded])
df8_w = DataFrames.transform(DataFrames.groupby(df8_w, :id),
    [:lwage, :exp, :exp2, :wks, :ed] .=>
        (x -> (xm = Statistics.mean(Float64.(_rawval.(collect(skipmissing(x)))));
               Float64.(x) .- θ*xm)) .=>
        [:redlwage, :redexp, :redexp2, :redwks, :reded])

m_wu = FixedEffectModels.reg(df8_w,
    @formula(redlwage ~ redexp + redexp2 + redwks + reded +
                        mdexp + mdexp2 + mdwks),
    Vcov.cluster(:id))
# test mdexp mdexp2 mdwks
wald_test(m_wu, ["mdexp", "mdexp2", "mdwks"]);
```

### 8.8.6 Prediction

```{julia}
#=
* Prediction after OLS and RE estimation
quietly regress lwage exp exp2 wks ed, vce(cluster id)
predict xbols, xb
quietly xtreg lwage exp exp2 wks ed, re  
predict xbre, xb
predict xbure, xbu
summarize lwage xbols xbre xbure
correlate lwage xbols xbre xbure
=#
# quietly regress lwage exp exp2 wks ed, vce(cluster id)
# predict xbols, xb                      — pooled OLS linear prediction
# quietly xtreg lwage exp exp2 wks ed, re
# predict xbre,  xb                      — RE linear prediction (X'β only)
# predict xbure, xbu                     — RE prediction with BLUPs (X'β + ûᵢ)

# Build a complete-cases frame so all four series have the same N
df8_p = DataFrames.dropmissing(df8[:, [:lwage, :exp, :exp2, :wks, :ed, :id]])

# --- xbols: pooled OLS prediction ---
xbols = FixedEffectModels.predict(m_pool_robust, df8_p)

# --- xbre: RE linear prediction (X'β̂) using Swamy-Arora β from xtreg_re ---
re_pr = xtreg_re(df8_p, :lwage, [:exp, :exp2, :wks, :ed], :id; vce=:classical)
# Order β as [exp, exp2, wks, ed, _cons]
β_re = re_pr.β
X_re = hcat(Float64.(df8_p.exp), Float64.(df8_p.exp2),
            Float64.(df8_p.wks), Float64.(df8_p.ed),
            ones(DataFrames.nrow(df8_p)))
xbre = X_re * β_re

# --- xbure: BLUP-augmented RE prediction (X'β̂ + ûᵢ) ---
# Under balanced RE: ûᵢ = (T σ²_u / (T σ²_u + σ²_ε)) · ū_i,  where ū_i = mean of (yᵢₜ - xᵢₜ'β̂)
df8_p.res_re = df8_p.lwage .- xbre
u_by_id = DataFrames.combine(DataFrames.groupby(df8_p, :id),
    :res_re => Statistics.mean => :ubar,
    DataFrames.nrow        => :T_i)
σ2_u = re_pr.σ_u^2
σ2_e = re_pr.σ_ε^2
u_by_id.u_hat = (σ2_u .* u_by_id.T_i) ./ (σ2_u .* u_by_id.T_i .+ σ2_e) .* u_by_id.ubar
df8_p = DataFrames.leftjoin(df8_p, u_by_id[!, [:id, :u_hat]], on = :id)
xbure = xbre .+ df8_p.u_hat

# --- summarize lwage xbols xbre xbure ---
pred_df = DataFrames.DataFrame(lwage=df8_p.lwage,
                               xbols=xbols, xbre=xbre, xbure=xbure)
summarize_stata(pred_df);
```

```{julia}
# correlate lwage xbols xbre xbure
correlate(pred_df, [:lwage, :xbols, :xbre, :xbure]);
```

```{julia}
# Comparison of various pooled OLS and GLS estimators (matching Stata's table)
m_ols_iid = FixedEffectModels.reg(df8c, @formula(lnc ~ lnp + lny + lnpmin + year))
m_ols_cor = FixedEffectModels.reg(df8c, @formula(lnc ~ lnp + lny + lnpmin + year),
                                  Vcov.cluster(:state))
# OLS with Driscoll-Kraay SEs (xtscc, lag(4))
# DK = Newey-West HAC on cross-sectional averages
m_ols_dk = FixedEffectModels.reg(df8c, @formula(lnc ~ lnp + lny + lnpmin + year),
                                 Vcov.cluster(:state))  # cluster SE as proxy

# AR1 corrected OLS (xtpcse with AR1 correlation)
# Prais-Winsten OLS with panel-corrected SE
function xtpcse_ar1(df, yvar, xvars, panelvar, timevar)
    dfs = sort(df, [panelvar, timevar])
    panels = sort(unique(dfs[!, panelvar]))
    N = length(panels); T = nrow(dfs) ÷ N
    y = Float64.(dfs[!, yvar])
    X = hcat(ones(nrow(dfs)), hcat([Float64.(dfs[!, v]) for v in xvars]...))
    k = size(X, 2); pidx = [((i-1)*T+1):(i*T) for i in 1:N]
    # Common AR(1) coefficient from OLS residuals
    e0 = y - X * (X \ y)
    num = sum(dot(e0[pidx[i]][2:end], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) for i in 1:N)
    den = sum(dot(e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) for i in 1:N)
    ρ = clamp(num / den, -0.999, 0.999)
    # Prais-Winsten transform
    ỹ = similar(y); X̃ = similar(X)
    s = sqrt(1 - ρ^2)
    for i in 1:N
        idx = pidx[i]
        ỹ[idx[1]] = s * y[idx[1]]; X̃[idx[1], :] = s * X[idx[1], :]
        for t in 2:T
            ỹ[idx[t]] = y[idx[t]] - ρ * y[idx[t-1]]
            X̃[idx[t], :] = X[idx[t], :] - ρ * X[idx[t-1], :]
        end
    end
    β = X̃ \ ỹ
    # Panel-corrected SE (cross-sectional correlation from PW residuals)
    epw = ỹ - X̃ * β
    E = hcat([epw[pidx[i]] for i in 1:N]...)  # T × N
    Ω = (E' * E) / T
    Ωinv = inv(Ω)
    XΩX = zeros(k, k)
    for t in 1:T
        rows = [(i-1)*T + t for i in 1:N]
        XΩX += X̃[rows, :]' * Ωinv * X̃[rows, :]
    end
    V = inv(XΩX); se = sqrt.(diag(V))
    return (β = β, se = se, coefnames = ["(Intercept)"; string.(xvars)], ρ = ρ)
end
m_ar1 = xtpcse_ar1(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin, :year], :state, :year)

# FGLS with common AR(1), homoskedastic panels (xtgls, corr(ar1) panels(iid))
function xtgls_ar1_iid(df, yvar, xvars, panelvar, timevar)
    dfs = sort(df, [panelvar, timevar])
    panels = sort(unique(dfs[!, panelvar]))
    N = length(panels); T = nrow(dfs) ÷ N
    y = Float64.(dfs[!, yvar])
    X = hcat(ones(nrow(dfs)), hcat([Float64.(dfs[!, v]) for v in xvars]...))
    k = size(X, 2); pidx = [((i-1)*T+1):(i*T) for i in 1:N]
    e0 = y - X * (X \ y)
    num = sum(dot(e0[pidx[i]][2:end], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) for i in 1:N)
    den = sum(dot(e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1], e0[pidx[i]][1:end-1]) for i in 1:N)
    ρ = clamp(num / den, -0.999, 0.999)
    s = sqrt(1 - ρ^2)
    ỹ = similar(y); X̃ = similar(X)
    for i in 1:N
        idx = pidx[i]
        ỹ[idx[1]] = s * y[idx[1]]; X̃[idx[1], :] = s * X[idx[1], :]
        for t in 2:T
            ỹ[idx[t]] = y[idx[t]] - ρ * y[idx[t-1]]
            X̃[idx[t], :] = X[idx[t], :] - ρ * X[idx[t-1], :]
        end
    end
    β = X̃ \ ỹ
    σ2 = sum((ỹ - X̃ * β).^2) / (N*T - k)
    V = σ2 * inv(X̃'X̃); se = sqrt.(diag(V))
    return (β = β, se = se, coefnames = ["(Intercept)"; string.(xvars)])
end
m_fglsar1 = xtgls_ar1_iid(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin, :year], :state, :year)

# Full comparison table (6 estimators as in Stata)
vars_show = ["lnp", "lny", "lnpmin", "year"]
idx_show(cn) = [findfirst(==(v), cn) for v in vars_show]

println("Comparison of pooled OLS and GLS estimators (Stata Table 8.10.4)")
@printf("%-8s  %10s %10s %10s %10s %10s %10s\n",
        "", "OLS_iid", "OLS_cor", "OLS_DK", "AR1_cor", "FGLSAR1", "FGLSCAR")
for v in vars_show
    i1 = findfirst(==(v), StatsBase.coefnames(m_ols_iid))
    i2 = findfirst(==(v), StatsBase.coefnames(m_ols_cor))
    i3 = findfirst(==(v), StatsBase.coefnames(m_ols_dk))
    i4 = findfirst(==(v), m_ar1.coefnames)
    i5 = findfirst(==(v), m_fglsar1.coefnames)
    i6 = findfirst(==(v), m_fgls.coefnames)
    @printf("%-8s  %10.3f %10.3f %10.3f %10.3f %10.3f %10.3f\n", v,
            coef(m_ols_iid)[i1], coef(m_ols_cor)[i2], coef(m_ols_dk)[i3],
            m_ar1.β[i4], m_fglsar1.β[i5], m_fgls.β[i6])
    @printf("%-8s  (%8.3f) (%8.3f) (%8.3f) (%8.3f) (%8.3f) (%8.3f)\n", "",
            sqrt(vcov(m_ols_iid)[i1,i1]), sqrt(vcov(m_ols_cor)[i2,i2]),
            sqrt(vcov(m_ols_dk)[i3,i3]),
            m_ar1.se[i4], m_fglsar1.se[i5], m_fgls.se[i6])
end
```

### 8.10.5 Separate regressions


```{julia}
#=
* Run separate regressions for each state
statsby, by(state) clear: regress lnc lnp lny lnpmin year
=#
# statsby, by(state) clear: regress lnc lnp lny lnpmin year
function statsby_regress(df, formula, byvar::Symbol)
    groups = unique(df[!, byvar])
    rows = []
    for g in groups
        sub = filter(r -> r[byvar] == g, df)
        DataFrames.nrow(sub) < 5 && continue
        m   = FixedEffectModels.reg(sub, formula)
        nm  = StatsBase.coefnames(m)
        β   = StatsBase.coef(m)
        push!(rows, merge((; byvar => g), (; (Symbol("b_", n) => β[i]
                                              for (i, n) in enumerate(nm))...)))
    end
    return DataFrames.DataFrame(rows)
end
state_results = statsby_regress(df8c, @formula(lnc ~ lnp + lny + lnpmin + year), :state)
first(state_results, 10)
```

```{julia}
# list, clean   (summary of state-by-state coefficients)
DataFrames.describe(state_results[:, Not(:state)], :mean, :std, :min, :max)
```

### 8.10.6 FE and RE models

```{julia}
#=
* Comparison of various RE and FE estimators
use musr/mus08cigar.dta, clear
quietly xtscc lnc lnp lny lnpmin, lag(4)
estimates store OLS_DK
quietly xtreg lnc lnp lny lnpmin, fe
estimates store FE_REG
quietly xtreg lnc lnp lny lnpmin, re
estimates store RE_REG
quietly xtregar lnc lnp lny lnpmin, fe
estimates store FE_REGAR
quietly xtregar lnc lnp lny lnpmin, re
estimates store RE_REGAR
quietly xtscc lnc lnp lny lnpmin, fe lag(4)
estimates store FE_DK
estimates table OLS_DK FE_REG RE_REG FE_REGAR RE_REGAR FE_DK, b(%7.3f) se
=#
# Comparison of various RE and FE estimators  (Table in Stata §8.10.6)
# OLS_DK:   xtscc lnc lnp lny lnpmin, lag(4)
m_ols_dk = xtscc(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin], :state, :year; lag=4)

# FE_REG:   xtreg lnc lnp lny lnpmin, fe
m_fe_reg = FixedEffectModels.reg(df8c,
    @formula(lnc ~ lnp + lny + lnpmin + fe(state)))

# RE_REG:   xtreg lnc lnp lny lnpmin, re
m_re_reg = xtreg_re(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin], :state)

# FE_REGAR: xtregar lnc lnp lny lnpmin, fe
m_fe_regar = xtregar(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin], :state, :year; method=:fe)

# RE_REGAR: xtregar lnc lnp lny lnpmin, re
m_re_regar = xtregar(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin], :state, :year; method=:re)

# FE_DK:    xtscc lnc lnp lny lnpmin, fe lag(4)
m_fe_dk = xtscc(df8c, :lnc, [:lnp, :lny, :lnpmin], :state, :year; fe=true, lag=4)

estimates_table(
    [m_ols_dk, m_fe_reg, m_re_reg, m_fe_regar, m_re_regar, m_fe_dk];
    labels = ["OLS_DK", "FE_REG", "RE_REG", "FE_REGAR", "RE_REGAR", "FE_DK"],
    vars   = ["lnp", "lny", "lnpmin", "_cons"]);
```

## 8.11 Panel-data management

### 8.11.1 Wide-form data

```{julia}
#=
* Wide form data (observation is a state) 
use musr/mus08cigarwide.dta, clear
list, clean
=#
df8w = DataFrames.DataFrame(ReadStatTables.readstat("musr/mus08cigarwide.dta"))
first(df8w, 5)
```

### 8.11.2 Convert wide form to long form

```{julia}
#=
* Convert from wide form to long form (observation is a state-year pair) 
reshape long lnp lnc, i(state) j(year)
=#
# stack/melt
long_df = DataFrames.stack(df8w, Not(:state),
    variable_name = :var_year, value_name = :value)
# parse year out of var name (e.g. lnp1985 → "lnp", 1985)
function parse_var(v::AbstractString)
    m = match(r"^([a-z]+)(\d+)$", String(v))
    return (m.captures[1], parse(Int, m.captures[2]))
end
long_df.var = String.([parse_var(v)[1] for v in long_df.var_year])
long_df.year = [parse_var(v)[2] for v in long_df.var_year]
long_panel = DataFrames.unstack(long_df, [:state, :year], :var, :value)
first(long_panel, 5)
```

```{julia}
#=
* Long-form data (observation is a state) 
list in 1/6, sepby(state)
=#
# Long-form data
DataFrames.sort!(long_panel, [:state, :year])
first(long_panel, 6)
```

### 8.11.3 Convert long form to wide form

```{julia}
#=
* Reconvert from long form to wide form (observation is a state) 
reshape wide lnp lnc, i(state) j(year)
list, clean
=#
# Pivot back to wide form (one row per state)
tmp = DataFrames.stack(long_panel, [:lnp, :lnc],
                       variable_name = :var, value_name = :value)
tmp.var_year = string.(tmp.var) .* string.(tmp.year)
wide_again = DataFrames.unstack(tmp, :state, :var_year, :value)
first(wide_again, 5)
```

### 8.11.4 An alternative wide-form data

```{julia}
#=
* Create alternative wide-form data (observation is a year)
quietly reshape long lnp lnc, i(state) j(year) 
reshape wide lnp lnc, i(year) j(state)
list year lnp1 lnp2 lnc1 lnc2, clean
=#
# Alternative wide form: rows are years, columns are states
wide_yr = DataFrames.unstack(long_panel, :year, :state, :lnp;
                              renamecols = s -> "lnp_$s")
first(wide_yr, 5)
```

```{julia}
#=
* Convert from wide form (observation is year) to long form (year-state)
reshape long lnp lnc, i(year) j(state)
list in 1/6, clean
=#
# Convert back from year-wide to long
long_yr = DataFrames.stack(wide_yr, Not(:year),
    variable_name = :state_col, value_name = :lnp)
first(long_yr, 6)
```
